project_name: Reusable grocery shopping bag that's NOT pain in the hand
blurb: Environmental friendly tote style packable / portable sling, with cushion padding. 12L yet tiny size. Ideal as back-up bag for travel
story_clean: A reusable bag people actually love to use again We never realize how much we depend on disposal shopping bags, until a real crisis hits the world. But reusable grocery bags are nothing new, why people weren't using them? Because people always forget to bring the reusable bags at check-out, and the thin handle or straps hurts hand or shoulder, especially when loaded with heavy items. Wouldn't it be great for a reusable bag to have a thick & comfortable handle, and can be packed so small that people bring it around all the time ? Meet Weei bag :)We designed Weei bag to be able to be packed into a super small size. When u need it, Weei bag can be unpacked into a full size tote bag. And the soft pack-cover can transform into a strap padding :) International shipping & tax friendlyOur shipping rate is quite reasonable to EU, UK, USA, and most Asian countries, mostly about 0 to 5 US dollars, and for most cases we already included tax within the reward price, so please click the reward to check the shipping rate for your area, we are sure you will find it within your budget :) A bag that's always there when u need itWeei bag is super handy as shopping bag, back-up travel bag, a beach trip bag, or a simple daily tote bag for minimalists. It can be packed into a very small size that you can easily take it with you all the time, and unpack to use it whenever you need. The weight of Weei bag is merely around 40 grams (1.4 oz), that's about of the weight of an AirPod, and its size is also just slightly bigger than an AirPod, therefore it can easily fit into pants' pocket. Weei bag in packed mode has a little loop for hooking onto a key-chain, backpack, or a shop cart. Weei bag also comes with a default little metal hook for clipping onto a shopping cart, or other bags. And of course, the metal hook can be removed from the bag or replaced by users' own hooks. There is also a loop on the side of the Weei bag in unpacked mode, for attaching the pack cover or anything else. No more hand / shoulder pain One of the most unique feature of Weei bag is the design of its pack cover. The pack cover is made of soft yet tough material (diving suit material), and there are 4 buttons at each corner, therefore it can be fold in 2 ways, vertically and horizontally. Once fold vertically, the pack cover turns into a cubic shape for holding the bag in packed mode. And when fold horizontally, the pack cover transform into a bar shape, and can be used as an insert cushion for the handle. How to insert?We made a small pocket beneath the strap of Weei bag, and the bar shape pack cover can be insert into this pocket, and become the padding of the strap. With the insert cushion, the padded strap is now thick, soft, and will not lose shape, providing a much better and comfortable carrying experience either by hand or by shoulder. All existing shopping bags claims to have wide handle to distribute pressure, in theory, but the fact is no matter how wide the handle starts with, it will lose shape under pressure, and collapse into thin strings that hurts skin. With Weei bag, the strap now is padded with thick soft cushion, and always holds its shape. No more pain, no more afraid of heavy loads or longer walk. Weei bag can be even more comfortable than most full-size hand bag, and we are very proud of this design :) Holds up to 20 lbsThe main material of Weei bag is high quality nylon, light weight, easy to clean, and very tough and durable. The structure of Weei bag is also carefully designed, so that it can handle quite some weight, up to about 10 kg or 20 pounds. 12L capacity or moreThe dimension of Weei bag is about 35cm by 40cm by 8cm, with about 11 to 12L capacity. Ideal for a quick grocery run, or as a travel back-up bag, etc. Weei bag's top is wide open, so in theory, if can fit even more than 12 L. Will multiple bags fits inside one pack cover? If one bag is not enough, could one pack cover be able to hold multiple bags? Well, the up limit is about 3 to 4 bags per pack cover. To be clear, each and every Weei bag comes with a pack cover. Info here is only for referrance, to those who may want to carry multiple bags within one pack cover. Stylish tote bag Weei bag can be carry as a sling tote bag. Ideal for a walk to park or beech :) Want to carry like a hand bag? No problem, Weei bag looks quite premium and stylish. Of course, Weei bag can be carried by hand, especially when the bag is relatively heavy, and the padded handle is super helpful. We offer 5 colors, blue, green, grey, orange, purple. We don't offer black color since it reminders us of trash bag. :( As for the color of the pack cover, it will be a matching color with the main bag, the one we show on the campaign page is the matching color for grey. We will share more info with update later on. :)12 USD per bag Generally, we offer Weei bag for kickstarter backers for 12USD per bag, as Early bird price with amount limit. Future retail price would be about 14 to 15 USD per. And on top of that, we also offer limited buy 3 get 1 FREE, and buy 4 get 2 FREE reward as special thanks to kickstarter backers, come and claim them now :) Also, if you want even more bags to share with your family or friends as gifts, you can add more bags through Add-on reward. :) Production plan Over all, Weei bag is relatively simple to make, therefore it won't be that much of a challenge for our manufacturer. And we will make sure the stitches are carefully crafted, and properly enhanced according to our requests. We are confident that we can handle the production. Usually, it takes about 2 weeks to collect backer order info, and we will then order materials, make cutting tooling, then move to production test, which takes about another 2 weeks. The final production should be finished in about 3 weeks, so about 6 to 7 weeks in total for production. Then we will start to arrange labeling and shipping, which should take about 2 weeks. After we ship the packages, we will be sending tracking info to each backer one by one.
risks: We spent lots of time with our suppliers, but things could still go wrong from time to time. Therefore, please give us bit more trust if time table is off, since we want to make good quality product onto your hands.
environmental_commitments: long_lasting_design: We use strong nylon materials to make the bag super durable for years to come, and one reusable shopping bag can potentially preventing hundreds of one-time plastic bags enter into trash bin. | reusability_and_recyclability: Our bag can be packed into extremely small size, therefore requires very little packaging wrap, thereby reducing packaging waste.

project_name: Grand Travel 2.0 - Limitless All Day & Travel Carry
blurb: A refined modular bag designed to move seamlessly from work to travel to everyday life. One bag. Every day. Every journey.
story_clean: One Bag For Everything Organize Like A Pro Effortlessly Classy Expands by 70% Two Successful Kickstarters Hidden Pocket Luggage Strap Modular Design Laptop Case | Add-On Travel Cube | Add-On Multi Case | Add-On Work, Travel, Enjoy Handcrafted With Precision
risks:
The Grand Travel 2.0 Collection is our third Kickstarter campaign and over the last six years our team has gained an incredible amount of experience on how to manufacture and fulfill premium bags and accessories to backers in over 160 countries.

MANUFACTURING: We are proud to have been working with the same manufacturing partners from day one. This relationship has strengthened over time as we have worked together through challenges. In addition, the stability of partnering with the same manufacturer has allowed us to build up the quality of our products as each detail gets focused on and perfected.

FULFILLMENT PARTNERS: We understand just how important it is to collaborate with the right fulfillment partners, and based on our timely delivery of over 10,000 worldwide orders in the previous four and a half years, we are confident that the logistics process is set up and ready to run smoothly even for a campaign that would significantly exceed its goal.

DESIGN CHANGES: The Grand Travel 2.0, as well as the add-ons that make up the Kickstarter Collection are final prototypes. These are extremely close to the final product that you will receive. It is important to keep in mind that the Kickstarter process is extremely valuable as it does allow us to continue receiving feedback from our backers and it allows our team more time to test and refine the design. If any small changes are implemented, these will always have the objective of delivering a better, more versatile or longer lasting product.

REFUNDS: Please keep in mind that refunds cannot be provided after the completion of the funding period of the Kickstarter campaign. Each Grand, Air and add-on is specifically crafted for an individual pledge made by a backer. Having said this, this does not in any way affect exchanges offered if manufacturing defects are encountered with your reward.
Please note that refunds cannot be granted as a result of potential shipping delays.

TIMELINE EXPECTATIONS: We now have the experience of successfully fulfilling two Kickstarter campaigns, so we have taken what we learned during the campaigns, as well as the knowledge gained in the past years to create a timeline with reasonable buffer for unexpected events. Although we don't anticipate facing global events of the magnitude of our first campaign which was crafted and delivered during Covid 19, we are realistic and open to the possibility of there being new, unforeseen circumstances that could lead to delays. If these do take place, our commitment is to always deal with them and communicate clearly with our backers as backer satisfaction is and will remain our top priority.
environmental_commitments:
environmentally_friendly_factories: Master Craftsmanship Over Mass-Manufacturing.
The Grand Travel 2.0 is produced in a specialized workshop by skilled leatherworkers with decades of experience. We intentionally prioritize a high-quality, small-batch production model over the waste of mass-manufacturing.

Amfori BSCI Certified: Our commitment to ethics is backed by a third-party audit. Our workshop is BSCI certified, which guarantees a safe, organized, and transparent environment where fair remuneration and workers' rights are strictly upheld.

Artisanal Expertise: Each bag is crafted by artisans who have spent years mastering leatherwork. Their expertise ensures that every stitch is precise, leading to a more durable product that doesn’t fail prematurely—the most effective way to reduce manufacturing waste.

"Zero-Waste" Modular Design: We maximize material efficiency through our modular ecosystem. While large panels are required for the main bag body, our smaller add-ons and accessories are specifically engineered to utilize the high-quality Saffiano off-cuts that would otherwise be discarded.

Direct Oversight: We maintain a close, personal relationship with our workshop. By focusing on a "quality—not speed" metric, we ensure that every reward is built with intention, avoiding the errors and environmental shortcuts common in high-speed, mass-production factories. | long_lasting_design: Built to Endure, Designed to be Restored.
The Grand Travel 2.0 is engineered to combat the widespread culture of planned obsolescence. In an era where most consumer products are designed to fail, degrade, and be replaced, we take the opposite approach: combining over-engineered durability with a modular repair ecosystem that keeps your bag in use for decades.

1. Industrial-Grade Resilience:
We’ve upgraded the core components to withstand the high-stress environment of frequent travel. This includes our new custom-engineered zippers, tested to be 12x more durable than industry standards, and the use of premium Saffiano and Heritage leathers—chosen for their natural resistance to scratches, structural warping, and water.

2. The Modular Repair Ecosystem:
We identified the three elements most prone to friction and weight-bearing wear over years of heavy use. To avoid the need for a total bag replacement, we designed these components to be user-replaceable in seconds:

Detachable Straps: High-tension clips allow for easy replacement if the hardware eventually tires.

Exchangeable Shoulder Pads: Refresh the comfort of your carry without buying a new strap.

Detachable Bag Handles: Our unique modular handle system allows you to swap out the most-touched part of the bag without tools or professional leatherwork.

By making these parts available individually, we ensure the Grand Travel 2.0 stays on the road and out of the landfill. | reusability_and_recyclability: One Bag, Many Lifetimes.
The Grand Travel 2.0 is built to stay in use and out of landfills through a modular, multi-functional design.

The 6-in-1 Utility: By replacing the need for separate handbags, backpacks, and carry-ons, we drastically reduce the total raw materials consumed by a single user.

Modular Restoration: The most high-friction components—handles, straps, and shoulder pads—are user-replaceable. If a part wears down after years of travel, you refresh the specific component instead of replacing the entire bag.

Resilient Saffiano: We chose Saffiano leather because it is scratch-resistant and does not warp or "age" like traditional leathers. It stays looking new for years, ensuring a high resale or "second-life" value rather than becoming waste.

Recyclable Packaging: We ship in a Premium Gift Box made from 100% recyclable cardboard, eliminating unnecessary single-use plastic packages from the delivery process. | something_else: A Commitment to Mindful Consumption.
Our design philosophy is rooted in the idea that owning one perfect item is better for the planet than owning five average ones.

The Power of 6-in-1: The Grand Travel 2.0 is engineered to replace the need for separate handbags, professional backpacks, gym bags, and travel carry-ons. By consolidating these functions into a single, high-quality chassis, we significantly reduce the cumulative environmental footprint and raw material consumption of our backers' lifestyles.

Production on Demand: As a Kickstarter-first brand, we only produce what our community pledges for. Unlike traditional retail brands that over-manufacture and discard unsold inventory at the end of a season, our "made-for-you" model ensures that zero products end up in a warehouse or landfill due to overproduction.

Design that Transcends Trends: We intentionally avoided fast-fashion aesthetics. By using Saffiano leather—which maintains its "like-new" look for years—and a timeless silhouette, we ensure that your bag remains relevant and beautiful for a lifetime, rather than being replaced when the next trend arrives. | sustainable_distribution: Optimized for a Lower Footprint.
We’ve streamlined our logistics to ensure the journey from our workshop to your doorstep is as efficient as possible, prioritizing lean distribution and waste reduction.

The Goal of the One-Way Trip: Shipping a product twice is one of the highest hidden environmental costs in e-commerce. While high-end boutique brands consider a 5% return rate to be the industry gold standard, our commitment to precision and durability has allowed us to maintain a return rate of less than 1.5%. By ensuring our rewards only ever take a "one-way trip" to our backers, we drastically cut down on the carbon emissions and packaging waste generated by the global return cycle.

Strategically Located Global Hub: Our fulfillment center is positioned in close proximity to our production workshops. This tight logistics loop minimizes the carbon footprint of the initial transit leg, allowing us to consolidate rewards and ship them through highly optimized global routes directly to our community, bypassing unnecessary middle-man global warehouses.

Recyclable Protection: We protect your reward using a Premium Gift Box made from 100% recyclable cardboard. This packaging is designed with a dual purpose: it is durable enough to be reused for long-term home storage or can be easily processed in standard paper recycling streams. | sustainable_materials: Selected for Permanence.
We use materials that prioritize a long product lifecycle, choosing durability as our primary path to sustainability.

Premium Saffiano Leather: Our Saffiano is a high-grade leather sourced as a by-product of the food industry. We transform these hides into a long-term functional tool rather than letting them go to waste.

Engineered for Resilience: Saffiano is chosen for its unique cross-hatch finish, which is naturally water-resistant and scratch-proof. Because it doesn’t warp or "wear down," the bag maintains its structural integrity and premium look for years.

Industrial-Strength Hardware: We utilize high-tension metal for our clips and zippers rather than plastic. By over-engineering these failure points, we ensure the bag remains functional for decades of travel.

Reinforced Lining: The interior features high-density, tear-resistant textiles designed to withstand the sharp edges of tech and travel gear without fraying or degrading.
